body.name: \mathsf{QCan}
body.construction: On \(G_{\mathrm{ABC}}\) and \(\mathcal J_{\mathrm{ABC}}\), first compare \(\mathcal A_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{raw}}\) with \(\mathcal A_{G,\mathcal J}^{\mathrm{simp-q}}\) by exact elimination of the raw product weights. If they agree, extract a product-factorization-preserving lift for every quotient-simplex point; if they differ, extract an algebraic point in the set difference with an exact first-order real-algebraic nonmembership certificate and retain the unquotiented compiler. For general \(G\) and \(\mathcal J\), start from the latent-incidence tensor network, refine \(\sim_{G,\mathcal J}\) by coordinate-context congruences, and repeat the equality-or-separation test.
